# Claude Code Local

> Run Claude Code against an open model on your own machine, with no cloud model and no API key. On an Apple Silicon Mac a small Python server (proxy/server.py) runs the model with Apple's MLX and answers Claude Code on http://localhost:4000 in Anthropic's Messages API format. On Linux and Windows the same install runs the model with llama.cpp. When you hit a Claude Code usage limit, type exit, then keep going, and the same conversation carries on with a local or free cloud model.

Install on a Mac or Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicedreamzapp/claude-code-local/main/install.sh | bash`

Install on Windows (PowerShell): `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicedreamzapp/claude-code-local/main/install.ps1 | iex`

Setup reads the machine's memory and graphics hardware and picks a model that fits. On a Mac: Qwen 3.5 2B 8-bit under 16 GB, Qwen 3.5 4B bf16 for 16 to 31 GB, Gemma 4 12B 4-bit for 32 to 63 GB, Gemma 4 31B 4-bit for 64 to 95 GB, Qwen 3.8 27B 8-bit for 96 GB and up. MIT licensed. Intel Macs are not supported.

## Guides

- [Hit your Claude Code usage limit? Keep going](https://nicedreamzapp.github.io/claude-code-local/usage-limit/): switch to a local model in one command and keep the same conversation
- [Run Claude Code offline on a Mac](https://nicedreamzapp.github.io/claude-code-local/claude-code-offline-mac/): install once, switch off background traffic, check with lsof
- [Use Claude Code without an API key](https://nicedreamzapp.github.io/claude-code-local/claude-code-without-api-key/): free, no key and no subscription
- [Claude Code on Apple Silicon with MLX](https://nicedreamzapp.github.io/claude-code-local/claude-code-apple-silicon-mlx/): M1 or newer, measured speeds, memory settings
- [Best model for a 16 GB or 8 GB Mac](https://nicedreamzapp.github.io/claude-code-local/best-local-model-small-mac/): Qwen 3.5 4B bf16 and Qwen 3.5 2B 8-bit
- [Which local model to run](https://nicedreamzapp.github.io/claude-code-local/which-local-model-claude-code/): the model for each memory size and GPU
- [Claude Code on Windows](https://nicedreamzapp.github.io/claude-code-local/claude-code-windows-local-model/): llama.cpp, one PowerShell line
- [Claude Code on Linux](https://nicedreamzapp.github.io/claude-code-local/claude-code-linux-local-model/): llama.cpp on NVIDIA, AMD/Vulkan or CPU
